d:
Why is France constantly on strike? From high-schoolers barricading classrooms in Paris suburbs to nationwide strikes that shut down rail networks and leave tons of uncollected garbage in the streets, France seems trapped in an endless loop of massive public unrest.
In this episode of The Blueprint, we look past the sensational news headlines to break down the real structural, historical, and constitutional reasons why French citizens turn to street protests as a primary political weapon and why this cycle of rebellion never truly stops.
